text:
naomi: quick sync 1 final run-of-show + routing for next week's webinar. working title: 'Operationalizing Predictable Inference'
ravi: love it. goal: give engineers an actionable checklist (when to pick Hosted/Dedicated/Private) + a short live rerank demo and clear lead next steps.
cass: suggested speakers: ravi (decision flow, 4m), leo (demo + ops, 10m), cass (benchmarks + leads, 5m), naomi (wrap + CTA, 1m)
leo: demo plan: small chat -> rerank reranking pass that shows improved selection. prefer Dedicated for lowest latency but can show Hosted numbers side-by-side. will prepare a recorded fallback.
naomi: please confirm demo dataset is synthetic. no customer PII. also need a 30s fallback video and console trace screenshot.
ravi: abstract draft: "A pragmatic playbook for choosing serving modes, tuning batching & caching, and routing traffic to keep inference predictable and cost-efficient. Includes a live rerank demo and post-webinar routing plan." feedback?
cass: add a line about routing & automatic fallback (model variants, region fallback) since that's a differentiator.
naomi: good call. run-of-show (20m strict):
```
- 0:00-0:00:45 - welcome & housekeeping (naomi)
- 0:00:45-0:04:30 - decision flow: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private (ravi)
- 0:04:30-0:14:30 - live demo: chat + rerank (leo)
- 0:14:30-0:19:30 - benchmarks, best-practices, routing (cass)
- 0:19:30-0:20:00 - quick Q&A highlight + CTA (naomi)
```
leo: rehearsal checklist: mic, screenshare order, demo creds in vault, pre-warm, fallback clip, backup laptop. will post pre-warm command.
leo: pre-warm example: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/instances/prewarm -d '{"model":"tiny-chat","seq":128}'`
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: rehearsal slot reserved: Tue 08:30-09:00 PT in #marketing-rehearsals
design-bot: :art: one-slide decision visual request received. due by Tue 16:00 PT (light + dark).
cass: routing rules proposal: demo requests OR intent >=2000 tokens/mo -> AE; everything else -> SDR. add checkboxes in follow-up for "inference_use_case" and "compliance / regulated" to escalate to enterprise.
naomi: agree. also auto-tag leads that selected "reranking" or "low-latency" for AE follow-up.
ravi: social copy note: emphasize the practical checklist & the rerank demo. CTA: request a hands-on trial + claim trial credits. keep tweet-sized variant for X and a longer LinkedIn post.
leo: fallback plan: record the demo (30s) + capture token breakdown trace. if live fails, we cut to recording and narrate the difference between Hosted/Dedicated.
naomi: ops: please add a CSV mapping template for leads -> AE/SDR by rule and share the follow-up doc link.
ops-bot: :spiral_note_pad: follow-up template created: https://confluence.redwood.ai/marketing/webinar-followup-operationalizing-inference
naomi: team ACKs? will update calendar and upload assets before rehearsal.
ravi: ack 1 will draft the one-slide decision tree and rehearse transitions with leo.
cass: ack 1 i'll prepare the benchmark slide (p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, $/1M tokens) and the lead CSV mapping.
leo: ack 1 will confirm Dedicated slot by EOD; otherwise we default to recorded demo.
design-bot: :pushpin: reminder set: decision visual due Tue 16:00.
naomi: perfect. final dry run Tue 08:30 and live Wed. I'll ping again with asset links.
